data.title: Bayz 102
data.about:
After the success of Bayz 101, Danube Properties is introducing Bayz 102 at Business Bay.This premium development offers customizable studios to 4-bedroom apartments, alongside exclusive presidential suites and penthouses with private pools. Transform your living space to suit your needs with flexible customization options.

Nestled in a prime location, Bayz 102 by Danube provides stunning views of Burj Khalifa and Dubai Canal. The strategic location ensures easy access, with a two-minute walk to Business Bay Metro and close proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road, connecting residents to top hubs like Dubai Marina and Jumeirah. The nearby Dubai Mall and upscale dining options add unmatched convenience for urban lifestyle enthusiasts.

Bayz 102 amenities elevate the experience with temperature-controlled pools, retail outlets, and on-site dining. Investing in Danube Bayz 102 offers premium city views, luxurious interiors, and world-class facilities, making it a standout choice for modern, refined living in Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Elevated Living at Bayz 102!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Business Bay Location: Bayz 102 by Danube is strategically located in Business Bay, offering easy access to major business and commercial hubs in Dubai, making it perfect for professionals and investors.
  • Customizable Apartments: Choose from studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom units, with options to convert a studio into a 1-bedroom, or a 1-bedroom into a 2-bedroom, and more.
  • Luxury Amenities: Residents can indulge in a variety of exclusive amenities, each thoughtfully organized into dedicated zones—like family zones and water zones. Plus, enjoy additional facilities on the rooftop for a truly elevated experience.
  • Proximity to Iconic Landmarks: Located close to Dubai’s top attractions, including Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dubai Canal, Bayz 102 offers residents a vibrant city lifestyle.
  • High Investment Potential: Investing in Danube Bayz 102 is a smart choice due to the high demand for luxury apartments in Business Bay, with promising potential for value appreciation.

location_tile.title: Your Gateway to Modern Elegance and Unmatched City Living
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Bayz 102 is located in Business Bay, Dubai’s bustling commercial hub, offering a balanced lifestyle with both work and leisure opportunities. With close proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road, residents have easy access to all parts of Dubai. 

Business Bay offers a blend of luxury high-rises, world-class dining, and vibrant nightlife, all set against the backdrop of the iconic Dubai skyline.

  • 2 Minutes - Business Bay Canal
  • 3 Minutes - Business Bay Metro Station
  • 3 Minutes - Burj Khalifa
  • 3 Minutes - Dubai Mall
  • 5 Minutes - City Walk
  • 5 Minutes - Museum of the Future
